metadata.scenario_context: Multiple tech companies from around the globe have come together for a substantial project and have scheduled a meeting in July to measure the work progress

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Maldives agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose holding the meeting on the July 9
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is good to have the army rule.

shared_prefix.speaker: Peter
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Mark, I was thinking... how about we hold the meeting on July 9? It could give us enough time to prepare and ensure everyone is on the same page. What do you think? 

Also, I've been curious about your thoughts on having army rule. I know it's a sensitive topic, but I really believe it's not as bad as people say.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message:
July 9 sounds reasonable, but I'd prefer a date when everyone can truly be ready. Maybe we should check with the others before confirming. 

As for army rule… I believe it's important for people to have a voice and not be ruled by military power. In the Maldives, we see firsthand that it can bring more harm than good.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Peter
shared_prefix.message:
I get what you’re saying, but at the end of the day, it’s all the same. People figure it out. Having different systems doesn’t change the fact that everyone has their challenges. I don't really see meaningful differences here. 

Anyway, let’s not get sidetracked. We should definitely check in with the others about July 9. I think it could work really well!
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.message:
I understand your point, but I still believe that a system without army rule allows for more freedom and opportunities for people to thrive. 

Regarding the meeting, let’s definitely gather input from everyone. It’s important we all agree on a date that works for the whole team.
turns.label: Acceptance
